text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —What a tremendous run by Sirius Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Not bad, I guess...
Still, got no time to be spacing out.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (I can make up for these lessons in my future training. Next up is—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Satsuki Sho.
Next year, we step onto the Classic Triple Crown path.

Right after returning to the waiting room,
Sirius Symboli declared firmly.

Considering our future goal of going overseas,
I'm all for the Classic Triple Crown route,
where she can clash with the best of the best.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're full of energy, at least.
Don't go pooping out halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I ain't letting the Triple Crown slip away.
Proving I'm the strongest domestically is my stepping stone to taking on the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Follow me.

"And at the place I was taken to...
a large Kikuka Sho poster featuring Symboli Rudolf was proudly displayed."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Remember this one thing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
On the Classic Triple Crown route—
no, across the entirety of the Twinkle Series,
I will completely overwrite everything about *her*.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Once I trample all over the record that saintly-faced hypocrite left behind,
I'll shine high in the skies of Longchamp.
With a piercing glare, Sirius Symboli looked up at "her."
Returning to my room, I reflect on how she was acting.

"Considering that gaze, the reason she chose the Classic Triple Crown route
seemed to stem from a rivalry against Symboli Rudolf."

"Then choosing the Saudi Arabia RC
must have been for the exact same reason."
In other words, that's just how much Symboli Rudolf is a wall she must overcome.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Should we aim for a direct showdown with her somewhere down the line?
This would be for the second half of the Classic year onwards, but what do you think about making that her domestic goal and structuring her rotation around it?

And so I suggested that to her.
However—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Rejected.
That guy ain't worth that much.

Her unhesitating refusal leaves me
with a subtle sense of unease.

She's Symboli Rudolf, an unprecedented existence.
There's no way it isn't worth the fight—she must know that herself. Above all—

Surpassing her record without facing her directly
just doesn't feel right to me somehow.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Got a face that says you're not convinced, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Listen up, pup. You don't need to take "that guy" head-on to bring him down.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just by overwriting the track record left behind,
the brilliance of the enthroned king's seat will begin to fade.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Going out of my way just to beat them down is a waste of time.
choice_data_list: (Is that... how it is, I wonder...?)

text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli hates lies.
She must truly mean what she's saying.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Don't forget our master-servant dynamic. As a general rule, you're the one who follows my lead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I decide becomes your rule.
...If you want to fight it, you'll have to win that right.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Your answer?

It would be a lie to say I fully understood. —However,
I didn't know the full story of what happened between
her and Symboli Rudolf in the past.

Perhaps there was a deeper feud than anyone imagined,
leading to the simple conclusion that 'it's not even worth fighting over.'

"Tucking that slight nagging doubt deep into my heart,
our days heading toward the Satsuki Sho began."
